name: scheduler-app
description: A comprehensive scheduling application similar to Calendly

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:watch: npx concurrently "npm run test:backend -- --watch" "npm run test:frontend"
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose up -d postgres redis
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && npx serve -s frontend/build
